allocation_definition: hierarchy-respecting Shapley/dominance allocation of Nakagawa marginal R-squared across refitted nested models; study site and light source are averaged over both admissible entry orders; the interaction enters only after both main effects
reference_invariance: nested-model value function; invariant to the factor reference levels
inferential_role: exploratory descriptive allocation; not a unique or causal partition and does not replace the accepted H03 primary mean model
